title: Zelda: Hyrule Terrors
description: Zelda-inspired Armor, Weapons, Mobs, and iconic gear from BOTW and TOTK!
body:
# ![](https://i.imgur.com/5wadonc.png)

Step into a Zelda-inspired world where danger lurks in every biome and the spoils of battle bring legendary power. _Hyrule Terrors_ brings iconic enemies, weapons, and armor from **Breath of the Wild** and **Tears of the Kingdom** into the world of Minecraft, breathing new life into your adventures.

***

## Features

### Hyrule Terrors

Summon or encounter four iconic creatures, each with their own behaviors, spawn rules, and custom attributes:

*   **Bokoblin** – Mischievous, chaotic creatures that spawn in large groups.
*   Leaders can spawn with a horn and alert nearby Bokoblins to come to their aid.
*   Leaders can drop a head that you can wear to prevent Bokoblins from attacking or alerting.

![Bokoblin](https://i.imgur.com/wjTopqh.png)

*   **Lizalfos** – Agile lizard warriors with poisonous traits.
*   Some Lizalfos will spawn carrying an obtainable spear.

![Lizalfos](https://i.imgur.com/Xiu2etK.png)

*   **Chuchu** – Bouncy blobs that spawn in packs.
*   Shoot them with a flaming projectile or light them on fire to turn them into a **Red Chuchu**!
*   Red Chuchus drop Red Chuchu Jelly.

![Chuchu](https://i.imgur.com/uUNTeFs.png) ![red_Chuchu](https://i.imgur.com/mVqRYd7.png)

*   **Keese** – Flying nuisances with an eerily large eye!
*   Keese can drop a Keese Eyeball that you can wear on your head.

![Keese](https://i.imgur.com/QAD1uRC.png) ![Keese Eyeball](https://i.imgur.com/FUcIzLv.png)

### Weapons & Mob Drop Loot

Vanquish foes and earn custom items and rare monster parts:

*   **Bokoblin Fang** and **Bokoblin Horn**
*   **Lizalfos Horn**, **Lizalfos Tail**, and **Lizalfos Talon**
*   **Chuchu Jelly** and **Red Chuchu Jelly**

Legendary weapons include:

*   **Lizalfos Horn Dagger** – Quick and deadly.
*   **Bokoblin Arm** – A creepy, still-living arm taken from a Bokoblin!

![Bokoblin Arm](https://i.imgur.com/Uf5Rxx9.gif)

*   **Silver Longsword**, **Knight's Claymore**, and **Boulder Breaker** – Each has unique damage and attack speed.
*   **Lizal Spear** – Right-click to perform a powerful diving attack.
*   **The Master Sword** – An extremely powerful weapon. The sword awakens while in the Nether or End, and can also awaken when fighting bosses or configured entities, granting it additional damage.
*   **Hylian Shield** – A strong and durable shield with powerful abilities.

### Armor Sets

Equip yourself for war with handcrafted armor inspired by Zelda:

*   **Zora Armor** – Sleek aquatic gear.

![Zora Armor](https://i.imgur.com/p1P5WCO.png)

*   **Hero Armor** – Hero of the Wild.

![Hero Armor](https://i.imgur.com/aDTbtSC.gif)

*   **Barbarian Armor** – Unleash your wild side.

![Barbarian Armor](https://i.imgur.com/kBYUsZa.png)

*   **Knight Armor** – A strong defense against dark forces.

![Knight Armor](https://i.imgur.com/fOV13jD.png)

*   **Evil Spirit Armor** – For those who walk the shadowy path.

![Evil Spirit Armor](https://i.imgur.com/0tuMiWU.png)

***

## Structures

Discover Bokoblin forts and hideouts throughout the world!

## Possible Future Plans

Future updates may include:

*   More unique Zelda gear
*   Additional structures
*   Boss mobs and mini-bosses
*   Possibly even more, depending on the mod's popularity!
